name: Vlog Opening
summary: Build a 12-22s vlog opening as a new timeline in one of three styles, chosen from the analysed footage of the open Project.

compatibility.selects: Development build only. Released-version compatibility is unverified.

de.name: Vlog-Opener
de.summary: Baut aus dem analysierten Material des offenen Projekts einen 12-22 Sekunden langen Vlog-Vorspann als neue Timeline, in einem von drei Stilen.

es.name: Intro de vlog
es.summary: Crea una intro de vlog de 12 a 22 segundos como nueva línea de tiempo, en uno de tres estilos, a partir del material analizado del proyecto abierto.

fr.name: Intro de vlog
fr.summary: Construit une intro de vlog de 12 a 22 secondes comme nouvelle timeline, dans l'un des trois styles, a partir des rushes analyses du projet ouvert.

it.name: Apertura vlog
it.summary: Crea un'apertura per vlog di 12-22 secondi come nuova timeline, in uno di tre stili, dal materiale analizzato del progetto aperto.

ja.name: Vlog オープニング
ja.summary: 開いているプロジェクトの解析済み素材から、3 つのスタイルのいずれかで 12〜22 秒の Vlog オープニングを新しいタイムラインとして作成します。

pt.name: Abertura de vlog
pt.summary: Cria uma abertura de vlog de 12 a 22 segundos como nova linha do tempo, em um de tres estilos, a partir do material analisado do projeto aberto.

tr.name: Vlog acilisi
tr.summary: Acik projenin analiz edilmis goruntulerinden, uc stilden biriyle 12-22 saniyelik bir vlog acilisi olusturur ve yeni bir zaman çizelgesi olarak kaydeder.

zh.name: Vlog 片头
zh.summary: 根据当前项目中已分析的素材，以三种风格之一生成 12-22 秒的 Vlog 片头，并保存为新的时间线。

inputs.label: Footage
inputs.hint: Clips from the trip, picked by what's in them.

variants.name: Vlog Opening · Whip cut
variants.summary: Fast whip pans between places, cut on the beat.

variants.name: Vlog Opening · Motion graphics
variants.summary: Place labels, title cards and an iris close.

variants.name: Vlog Opening · Funny quotes
variants.summary: Your funniest lines over the footage.

inputs.label: Talking clips
inputs.hint: Clips where someone talks. The funniest lines become the captions.

prepare: 3 or more clips of people talking
Analyzed, so there's speech to quote
